#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    CinaVault Premium — Build 111 Standalone Installer
    Emby Fusion Edition with Full Plugin System
.DESCRIPTION
    Self-extracting installer that deploys the complete CinaVault Premium
    application including:
    - Persistent settings (save on exit, restore on startup)
    - Working OneDrive & Google Drive cloud storage buttons
    - Metadata submenu with provider selection & task scheduling
    - 98+ plugins (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex) with CinaVault compatibility
    - Premium UI features enabled as default standard
    - Full Tauri v2 + React 18 + Rust backend
.NOTES
    Version: 1.0.0 Build 111
    Author:  CinaVault Team
    Date:    2026-05-03
#>

param(
    [string]$InstallPath = "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\CinaVault-Premium",
    [switch]$SkipDeps,
    [switch]$DevMode
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$ProgressPreference = "SilentlyContinue"

function Write-Step {
    param([string]$Message, [string]$Status = "INFO")
    $colors = @{ "INFO" = "Cyan"; "OK" = "Green"; "WARN" = "Yellow"; "ERR" = "Red"; "DONE" = "Magenta" }
    $color = $colors[$Status]
    if (-not $color) { $color = "White" }
    Write-Host "  [$Status] " -ForegroundColor $color -NoNewline
    Write-Host $Message
}

# ── Prerequisite Checks ──
function Test-Prerequisites {
    Write-Host "`n  Checking prerequisites..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

    # Node.js
    $node = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($node) {
        $nodeVer = & node --version 2>$null
        Write-Step "Node.js $nodeVer found" "OK"
    } else {
        Write-Step "Node.js not found — will need manual install" "WARN"
    }

    # npm
    $npm = Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($npm) {
        Write-Step "npm found" "OK"
    } else {
        Write-Step "npm not found" "WARN"
    }

    # Rust / Cargo
    $cargo = Get-Command cargo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cargo) {
        $cargoVer = & cargo --version 2>$null
        Write-Step "Rust: $cargoVer" "OK"
    } else {
        Write-Step "Rust/Cargo not found — needed for Tauri build" "WARN"
    }

    # Tauri CLI
    $tauri = Get-Command cargo-tauri -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $tauri) {
        $tauri = Get-Command tauri -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    if ($tauri) {
        Write-Step "Tauri CLI found" "OK"
    } else {
        Write-Step "Tauri CLI not found — install with: cargo install tauri-cli" "WARN"
    }
}

# ── Install Dependencies ──
function Install-Dependencies {
    param([string]$ProjectPath)

    if ($SkipDeps) {
        Write-Step "Skipping dependency installation (--SkipDeps)" "INFO"
        return
    }

    Write-Host "`n  Installing dependencies..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $ProjectPath

    # npm install
    if (Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Write-Step "Running npm install..." "INFO"
        & npm install --legacy-peer-deps 2>&1 | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            Write-Step "npm dependencies installed" "OK"
        } else {
            Write-Step "npm install had issues — try manually" "WARN"
        }
    }

    Pop-Location
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Extract & Deploy
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function Deploy-SourceFiles {
    param([string]$TargetPath)

    Write-Host "`n  Extracting source files..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $count = 0
    $total = $SourceFiles.Count

    foreach ($entry in $SourceFiles.GetEnumerator()) {
        $filePath = Join-Path $TargetPath $entry.Key
        $dirPath = Split-Path $filePath -Parent

        if (-not (Test-Path $dirPath)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dirPath -Force | Out-Null
        }

        $bytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($entry.Value)
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($filePath, $bytes)
        $count++

        # Progress
        $pct = [math]::Round(($count / $total) * 100)
        Write-Progress -Activity "Extracting CinaVault Premium" -Status "$count / $total files ($pct%)" -PercentComplete $pct
    }

    Write-Progress -Activity "Extracting CinaVault Premium" -Completed
    Write-Step "$count files extracted successfully" "OK"
}

# ── Create Plugin Directories ──
function Initialize-PluginDirs {
    param([string]$TargetPath)

    $pluginDirs = @(
        "plugins/jellyfin",
        "plugins/emby",
        "plugins/plex",
        "plugins/native",
        "data/thumbnails",
        "data/chapters",
        "data/metadata",
        "data/cache",
        "data/backups",
        "data/logs"
    )

    foreach ($dir in $pluginDirs) {
        $fullPath = Join-Path $TargetPath $dir
        if (-not (Test-Path $fullPath)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $fullPath -Force | Out-Null
        }
    }
    Write-Step "Plugin & data directories initialized" "OK"
}

# ── Create Desktop Shortcut ──
function New-DesktopShortcut {
    param([string]$TargetPath)

    try {
        $desktop = [Environment]::GetFolderPath("Desktop")
        $shortcutPath = Join-Path $desktop "CinaVault Premium.lnk"
        $shell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
        $shortcut = $shell.CreateShortcut($shortcutPath)
        $shortcut.TargetPath = "cmd.exe"
        $shortcut.Arguments = "/c cd /d `"$TargetPath`" && npm run tauri dev"
        $shortcut.WorkingDirectory = $TargetPath
        $shortcut.Description = "CinaVault Premium — Emby Fusion Edition"
        $shortcut.Save()
        Write-Step "Desktop shortcut created" "OK"
    } catch {
        Write-Step "Could not create shortcut: $_" "WARN"
    }
}

# ── Generate Build Summary ──
function Show-Summary {
    param([string]$TargetPath)

    $fileCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $TargetPath -Recurse -File |
        Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules|target|dist' }).Count

    Write-Host "`n" -NoNewline
    Write-Host "  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "  ║          CINAVAULT PREMIUM — INSTALL COMPLETE           ║" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "  ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Step "Location: $TargetPath" "DONE"
    Write-Step "Files deployed: $fileCount" "DONE"
    Write-Step "Build: 111 (Premium Edition)" "DONE"
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    Write-Host "  │  NEW IN BUILD 111:                                     │" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    Write-Host "  │                                                        │" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ Persistent settings (save on exit / restore)       │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ OneDrive & Google Drive buttons now functional     │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ Metadata submenu with provider select/deselect     │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ Scheduled tasks (thumbnails, chapters, metadata)   │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ 98 plugins (Jellyfin + Emby + Plex) pre-loaded    │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ Plugin compatibility adapter engine                │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ Premium UI features as default standard            │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │  ✅ Auto-save every 60s + save on window close         │" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  │                                                        │" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    Write-Host "  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  TO BUILD & RUN:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "    cd `"$TargetPath`"" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "    npm install --legacy-peer-deps" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "    npm run tauri dev" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  TO BUILD RELEASE:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "    npm run tauri build" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host ""
}

# Install deps

    Install-Dependencies -ProjectPath $targetPath
}

# Shortcut

# Summary
